correctness.rationale: The proof first forces \(\operatorname{Im}R\subseteq J\), then derives \(R^2=0\) and rank at most two. Rank two reduces to a two-dimensional square-zero image plane and an explicit stabilizer action whose three strata have complete invariants. Rank one reduces to the condition \(f(vE+Ev)=0\), after which the characteristic socle line separates two triples of orbits. The bundled symbolic checker independently verifies every displayed representative and all conjugation formulas used in the orbit proof.

value.rationale: The automorphism quotient is the natural moduli problem for operators on a fixed algebra. It converts a large raw solution family and an older nonunique normal slice into a small intrinsic classification, isolates the real sign phenomenon, and gives exact parameters needed when comparing Rota–Baxter-induced structures up to algebra isomorphism.
